modalLead: Settings stand in tiles again, and Glass lets the theme's colour through instead of a white light.

items.text: Each group of settings sits in a tile again. They were drawn as one flat list, and with eighteen settings on a tab nothing showed where one group ended and the next began.

Glass is quieter, and carries colour rather than light. Every pane lifted what was behind it and wore a bright rim, so a column of them read as a column of lighter boxes. The sheen is about a third of what it was and takes the theme's own colour, so you see through the glass instead of at it.
The change reaches every theme on the Glass depth — the settings tiles, the search window, the menus and the card layouts alike.
